lines.text: Le désir coule dans mes veines
Oh, udti patang jaise, mast-malang jaise
Masti si chadh gayi humko turant jaise
Lagti current jaise, nikla warrant jaise
Abhi-abhi utra ho net se torrent jaise
Khilti basant jaise, dhulta kalank jaise
Dil ki daraar mein ho pyaar ka cement jaise
Akhiyaan hi akhiyon mein jung ki front jaise
Mil jaaye sadiyon se atka refund jaise
Kamli kahaaniyon si, jangli jawaaniyon si
Behti rawaaniyon si, hansti shaitaaniyon si
Chadh gayi hum pe badi meherbaaniyon si
Le désir coule dans mes veines
